answer: A farm faking 158 aliases needs 158 separate verifiable records of this kind, each checked against the issuing authority, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Ventriloquist act record works as the check: shows played at one circuit across years of halls. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The mirror record shows the asymmetry: scale multiplies the cost but never the reward, the thread entry is checkable by anyone, and the inlet window closes before a farm can catch up.
